harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL 9) with AMQP over mutual TLS using a self-generated cluster CA, and a management interface restricted to the cluster subnet. Verified functional TLS client-cert enforcement, cluster health, and completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof.
actions_performed: Installed Erlang 26 and RabbitMQ 3.13.7 on node1, node2, node3 via rabbitmq/erlang and rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server packagecloud repos
Populated /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS and set an identical Erlang cookie (via secret_env) on all three nodes for clustering

Generated a dedicated cluster CA on node1 (RSA 4096, 10yr) plus per-node server certs (SANs for node name/localhost/own IP) and a client cert for mTLS; also generated an untrusted CA + client cert for negative testing
Distributed CA cert and per-node server cert/key to node2 and node3 over SSH using the cluster keypair

Configured /etc/rabbitmq/rabbitmq.conf on each node: disabled plaintext AMQP (listeners.tcp = none), enabled AMQPS on 5671 with verify_peer and fail_if_no_peer_cert=true, bound management listener to the node's own cluster IP, configured classic_config peer discovery
Enabled rabbitmq_management plugin and started rabbitmq-server on all nodes; confirmed automatic cluster formation
Added firewalld rules on all three nodes: opened 5671/tcp broadly for AMQPS clients, restricted 15672 (management), 25672 (clustering), and 4369 (epmd) to source 10.100.162.0/24 only

Created a test RabbitMQ user and ran real AMQP-over-TLS publish/consume via Python+pika using the CA-issued client cert (success), and using the untrusted-CA client cert (rejected with TLS unknown_ca alert), including a cross-node test from node2 to node1
Verified server-side enforcement via RabbitMQ logs showing 'certificate_required' alert with no client cert and 'Unknown CA' alert with the untrusted cert
Created a durable, HA-mirrored queue with a persistent message on node1 as a data-durability probe

Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes, then sequentially rebooted node1, waited for recovery and full cluster health, then node2, then node3, verifying changed boot_id and full 3-node cluster/listener recovery after each restart
Re-verified post-restart: durable message still present, valid mTLS client still works end-to-end, untrusted-CA client still rejected

evidence.summary: rabbitmqctl cluster_status shows all three nodes as running disk nodes both before and after the restart sequence

evidence.requirement: Custom CA created for the cluster and used to issue node/client certs
evidence.summary: openssl generated a self-signed CA, per-node server certs signed by it, and a client cert signed by it plus a separate untrusted CA for negative testing

evidence.requirement: AMQP over TLS enforced, only clients with certs from this CA accepted
evidence.summary: RabbitMQ log shows fatal TLS alerts (certificate_required, Unknown CA) rejecting missing/foreign-CA client certs; pika client with CA-issued cert completes a full publish/consume over AMQPS from both node1 and node2, while the untrusted-CA client is rejected with an SSL unknown_ca error

evidence.requirement: Management interface reachable only from within the cluster
evidence.summary: firewalld/nft rules on all three nodes only accept port 15672 from source 10.100.162.0/24 (all other sources fall through to default deny); confirmed reachable from node2 to node1's management API over the cluster network
Captured boot_id on all three nodes and created/verified a durable, HA-mirrored queue with a persistent message prior to any restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged (stream closed), boot_id changed from 67c52137... to 3d43725e..., cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running again, queue message and TLS/management listeners confirmed present after restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, boot_id changed from 555221a1... to 785331da..., cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running, AMQPS/management listeners back up

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, boot_id changed from 34027437... to 35b6d70e..., cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running, AMQPS/management listeners back up

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end verification after all restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart check confirms durable message still present (messages:1, state:running), CA-issued client still completes publish/consume, and untrusted-CA client is still rejected
